prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut demi statue portrait, five-material body (symmetric), every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh-stub tips just below her hip line, where the two thighs have only just begun to separate, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Chinese woman in weixun makeup — clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, long black hair loosely tousled with a few strands across the face, a dreamy, half-lidded expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big rose-gold hoop hangs clear of the neck down to the shoulder.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest wider than her shoulders, a waistline that still pulls in sharply, then an enormous belly and colossal wide hips flaring out again, her left arm crystal, her right arm carved stone, her torso a glass vessel, her thigh-stub-stubs wood and wood.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent golden-yellow citrine crystal, one continuous carved mass, never hollow. Light passes straight through it. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid banded green malachite with concentric rings, completely opaque, completely opaque. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (chest, belly, hips): a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled completely to the brim with clear clear sapphire-blue water with drifting stars, no hollow space, no air gap. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through it, rising to the collarbone line itself.

Left thigh-stub (hip to tip): carved from ONE solid block of warm cream-to-tan olive wood with dark swirling grain, completely opaque, completely opaque. Just below her hip line, where the two thighs have only just begun to separate, her left thigh-stub curves inward and rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip — the wood simply reaching its natural end there. Right thigh-stub (hip to tip): carved from ONE solid block of warm cream-to-tan olive wood with dark swirling grain, completely opaque, completely opaque. Just below her hip line, where the two thighs have only just begun to separate, her right thigh-stub curves inward and rounds off into its own small, smooth, satin-polished carved tip — the wood simply reaching its natural end there.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a soft cream white on one side and a deep crimson red on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so white light glances off one side and red light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
